description: This file defines the 'BankingService' interface within the 'com.coding.exercise.bankapp.service' package. It declares methods for customer management, account handling, and transaction operations in a banking application.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: Interface for banking operations including customer, account, and transaction management.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with provided details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds customer details by their customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates customer information based on customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves account details using the account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account associated with a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles transferring funds between accounts based on transfer details.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of transaction details for a specific account.
